description: Live variant of workflow.run_impermanent_loss: fetches each token's current live USD price (Solana or any of 5 EVM chains) and derives currentPrice as their ratio, instead of it being supplied manually. entryPrice stays a manual, historical input (a fact the caller must supply, not something a live quote should overwrite), same convention as every other live-capable tool in this product. Use when the caller has the pool's two token addresses but doesn't already know the current price ratio. Returns the same fields as workflow.run_impermanent_loss, plus currentPrice, baseSymbol, quoteSymbol, routable (false + error if either token's price can't be resolved).

baseChain.description: Chain of the base (volatile) token. Default solana.

depositValueUsd.description: Optional: USD value deposited at entry

entryPrice.description: Base token's price in quote-token terms when liquidity was deposited (manual - a historical fact)

feesEarnedUsd.description: Optional trading fees earned so far in USD (default 0)

lowerPrice.description: Range lower bound - required for concentrated mode

quoteChain.description: Chain of the quote token. Default solana.

upperPrice.description: Range upper bound - required for concentrated mode

name: workflow.run_impermanent_loss_live
